_doc: v4.5 cow art config (drop-in by FILENAME). Files live in vendor/cr9_cows. `npm run build` runs tools/make_cow_sheet.py first and rebuilds the ONE cow sheet. Regular kills = cow_hybrid3_<type> (black alien eyes, no blink/eye swap). HYPER kills = bald gray cow_shred_<name>(_spotted) per shredKills.
_shredKills: FLAG: 'bald' = kills during HYPER MODE make bald gray cows (golden stays a rare random drop). 'golden' = HYPER kills make the golden cow instead.
_sleepy: pass-2 hook: if IKE's sleepy-eyed frame exists it is packed on the same sheet; the cow forms sleepy, holds 0.4 s, then SNAPS to the black-eyed hybrid3 frame with a small scale pop. Missing file = current behaviour.
